query:
SELECT a.room_id
              FROM room_memberships AS a
              JOIN room_memberships AS b ON a.room_id = b.room_id
             WHERE a.user_id = $1
               AND a.membership = 'join'
               AND b.user_id = $2
               AND b.membership = 'join'
               AND ($3::text IS NULL OR a.room_id > $3::text)
          ORDER BY a.room_id
             LIMIT $4
